Conduct a competitor analysis for my business [describe your business in 1-2 sentences]. My top 3 competitors are:
1. [Competitor 1 — name, website]
2. [Competitor 2 — name, website]
3. [Competitor 3 — name, website]
For each competitor, analyze: (1) Their core offering and positioning, (2) Pricing structure (if publicly available), (3) Target audience, (4) Strengths (what they do well that I should learn from), (5) Weaknesses (gaps I could exploit), (6) Their messaging and brand voice, (7) Content/marketing channels they use. Then give me: a comparison table, 3 opportunities I can exploit that they're missing, and a one-paragraph positioning recommendation for how I should differentiate.
